sources.title: Virginia Employer Withholding Tables for Wages Paid after July 1, 2025
Virginia Income Tax Withholding Guide for Employers

rounding.exactFormula: Official example retains cents; no separate formula-rounding sequence stated

supplementalWages.paidWithRegularWages: Aggregate and use table or formula
supplementalWages.paidSeparately: Aggregate with current or last regular payroll, subtract regular-wage tax

residencyAndWorkRules.residentRule: Virginia withholding applies to Virginia residents performing services inside or outside Virginia unless a valid exemption or reciprocal-state arrangement applies.
residencyAndWorkRules.nonresidentRule: Wages for Virginia services are subject unless the nonresident satisfies a reciprocal agreement or another exclusion.
residencyAndWorkRules.kentuckyAndDcCondition: Employee must reside there and commute daily to a Virginia workplace.
marylandWestVirginiaPennsylvaniaConditio: Lives in Virginia fewer than 183 days or not at all
Only Virginia-source income is salary or wages
Virginia wages are taxable by state of domicile

frequencies.due: Last day of month after quarter

frequencies.paymentTrigger: More than $500 accumulated at federal deposit cutoff

frequencies.due: 25th day following each designated active month

captureWarnings: The withholding formula uses $8,750 for all employees even though the publication separately discusses a $17,500 married-joint return-level standard deduction; the latter must not be substituted into payroll.
The standard-deduction increase is scheduled to sunset after tax year 2026, so 2027 requires a new effective-dated version.
The complete approximate wage-table matrices are checksummed but not transcribed.
No mixed-location allocation formula was located.
